blurb: Welcome to Fundy Woods, the perfect home base for your Bay of Fundy, Fundy Trail Provincial Park adventures and Fundy-St. Martins experiences. Whether you’re a tenting fan, an RV enthusiast or just looking for your next cottage getaway, get ready to experience the magic of the Bay of Fundy-home of the highest tides in the world.
